children.value: > Fact From Story: Users can also share their content to “Our Story,” a collaborative public archive of Stories posted from popular locations, which are displayed as hotspots on a “heat map.”
> > Fact From Story: If many users are posting Stories from around the same location, like a music festival, it’ll show up on the heat map.
> > > Fact From Story: Users are also turning to Snapchat for information about Gaza as accusations of shadowbanning Palestinian content fuel distrust in platforms like Instagram and Facebook.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: When people distrust a source of information, they will seek information from other sources.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A location with a lot of activity will have a hotspot on a heat map.
> Fact From Story: Snap Map first launched in 2017 as a location-sharing feature that lets users see where their friends are posting Stories from, displayed on an interactive map.
> > Fact From Story: Users can also share their content to “Our Story,” a collaborative public archive of Stories posted from popular locations, which are displayed as hotspots on a “heat map.”
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A feature that allows users to see where their friends are posting stories from can be used to get firsthand perspectives from those locations.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Firsthand perspectives are often shared through the posting of content in collaborative public archives.
